answer: Farming becomes a reef bet on surviving 74 epochs of grading, and every jade settlement recomputes the sonnet schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 74 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 18 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 7 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
